name: DocViewer — In-Tab Office Viewer
description: Preview Word, Excel and PowerPoint files directly in a Chrome tab — no download, no account, no upload.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https: blob: data:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self' blob:
